# technitium_record_sshfp (Resource)

Manages a single `SSHFP` record in an authoritative zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_zone" "sshfp_home" {
  zone = "sshfp.example.com"
}

resource "technitium_record_sshfp" "host" {
  zone                   = technitium_zone.sshfp_home.zone
  domain                 = "host.sshfp.example.com"
  sshfp_algorithm        = "Ed25519"
  sshfp_fingerprint_type = "SHA256"
  sshfp_fingerprint      = "D4A7E3B0C44298FC1C149AFBF4C8996FB92427AE41E4649B934CA495991B7852"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The record's domain name, for example `www.example.com`. Use the zone name for a record at the zone apex.
- `sshfp_algorithm` (String) The SSH key algorithm: `RSA`, `DSA`, `ECDSA`, `Ed25519` or `Ed448`.
- `sshfp_fingerprint` (String) The SSH key fingerprint as a hex string.
- `sshfp_fingerprint_type` (String) The fingerprint algorithm: `SHA1` or `SHA256`.
- `zone` (String) The authoritative zone that holds the record.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments stored with the record.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable the record without deleting it. Defaults to `false`.
- `expiry_ttl` (Number) Deletes the record automatically this many seconds after it was last modified. Terraform then creates it again on the next apply. Defaults to `0`, which keeps the record.
- `ttl` (Number) The record TTL in seconds. Defaults to the default record TTL in the server settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# zone/domain/sshfp_algorithm/sshfp_fingerprint_type/sshfp_fingerprint
terraform import technitium_record_sshfp.host sshfp.example.com/host.sshfp.example.com/Ed25519/SHA256/D4A7E3B0C44298FC1C149AFBF4C8996FB92427AE41E4649B934CA495991B7852
```
